statement: For a gamepad application collection, xpadneo configures signed sticks from -32768 to 32767 with fuzz 32 and default flat 3072, two 0..1023 triggers with fuzz 4, and an extra ABS_PROFILE axis ranging 0..3. It can change stick deadzone handling by module option. These post-driver Linux evdev capabilities are not equivalent to the 26-capability stock xpad benchmark in corpus PR 116.
